verdict.rationale: The required morning session makes arriving the prior evening important, but every option does so. A offers relatively early arrival with one connection at a midrange fare; C is cheaper with a much safer connection but arrives slightly later; D is cheapest and earliest but has two connections and therefore more disruption risk; B eliminates connection risk but arrives later and costs more. Choosing among cost, arrival time, layover safety, and connection count requires an unstated preference.
